findings.message: PROCESS, not a defect: both node passes of the contracted revision agreed on four items, fixed together here — argv[0] was an unredacted and uncapped channel (a credential-shaped program name was reproduced, and the notice path had no length cap), a test still imported the deleted redaction helper, comments still described the deleted redaction, and docs/security.md listed the audit trail as covering attempts a configuration withholds (which never reach the runner and are not audited). `displayProgram` now enforces the rendering in one place.
